sentences.en: He used to haunt those caves as a little boy.
sentences.zh: 他小时候常去那些山洞。

sentences.en: "You will be haunted," resumed the Ghost, "by Three Spirits."
sentences.zh: ‘幽灵继续说道：你会被三个鬼魂萦绕。’

sentences.en: My past indiscretions are coming back to haunt me.
sentences.zh: 我过去的不当行为正在回来困扰我。

senses.zh: 常出没于…；萦绕于…；经常去…
